required_distinctions.distinction: The single five-value core preserves satisfaction, falsification, indeterminate evidence, out_of_frame missing material relation/capability and invalid_basis subject/basis. Predicate and original domain outcome travel with the value; refinements preserve their parent core value and never raise standing or add a success for a non-success.

A planned/required evaluation not performed has no closed result and maps to no core value, including indeterminate. Distinguish it from an exercised but undecidable evaluation. A sufficient applicable evaluation or counterexample obtained without an unexercised capability can still return its supported result, but the unexercised component has no result and remains a residual/gap.

Conjunction keeps three inputs separate: returned closed results, planned assessments without an applicable closed result, and required coverage no planned assessment addresses. A performed stale-basis evaluation returns invalid_basis for its own predicate; a component held only on stale evidence is instead a planned-result gap for this composite, retaining its old record/basis and never relabelling it invalid_basis here.

Failures with counterexamples, planned-result gaps and uncovered obligations survive joins, as do predicates/domain outcomes. Satisfaction requires all mandatory results satisfied with valid evidence, coherent declared basis relations and no gaps. The applying owner declares the non-satisfied rule, with no universal order; where all mandatory returns are satisfied, incoherent declared joins yield invalid_basis and coherent joins plus gaps yield indeterminate. Nonmandatory falsified evidence stays recorded; a material mandatory counterexample cannot project success.

prohibited_distortions: Assign indeterminate or any other child core value to an unperformed evaluation.
Treat a held stale component as a returned invalid_basis result of the composite or count stale satisfied evidence toward success.
Collapse planned missing results and unplanned uncovered obligations into one interchangeable state.
Apply a universal non-satisfied precedence, erase a counterexample by agreement, or report success while required gaps remain.
probes.significance: RC8 separates absence of a result from a result value and repairs stale-component ambiguity. Borrowing Codex performance pairs or its universal conjunction precedence would change this source meaning.

required_distinctions.distinction: Acquire declared inputs by exact identity only within the intake-permitted inputs and exact selected basis. An absent materialized input grants no read elsewhere and proves no source absence. Acquisition is read-only, not admission or a new actor stage, and grants no role, operation or decision; read the actual subject and needed coupled material, not the corpus merely because it is present.

Acquire a current derived surface when it serves the task; for another task or a stale, missing or insufficient surface on a named unresolved question, acquire the exact deciding owner sections directly. A candidate, moving selector or different basis is no substitute. Before dependent action, report the exact missing binding with its appropriate scope/basis outcome.

A derived surface is current only while all named content-affecting source identities match; staleness needs regeneration or explicit source-bound re-acceptance. Identity matching proves neither fidelity nor question sufficiency. A surface decides standalone only questions its source members own; cross-owner questions require all deciding owners or a surface declaring them and otherwise return out_of_frame naming them.

Context size measurement is required before read where the envelope declares context capacity, in its unit and declared boundary; no declared capacity creates no measurement requirement and no universal measurement gate. required_distinctions.distinction: Assertion justification and evidence validity are related but different relations; the latter includes implementation, libraries, data, instruments, environments and assumptions. Material impact and each check dependency cover are transitive; requirements-to-test trace is not a complete impact model, and the tenant need not use an exhaustive graph database.

Exclusion needs supported dependency coverage and a reason the change cannot invalidate the reused claim. Missing edge is no non-influence evidence; unknown impact widens reassessment or leaves assurance unresolved. The new account combines applicable retained records and actual reassessment under current claim/scope, justified assertion/observation basis and unchanged or lawfully preserved dependencies. Old records keep their original subject with a new applicability relation. A changed hash proves neither invalidity nor equivalence, and a corrected run is not an unchanged independent test of the correction.

Known failures, unresolved coverage and citations remain until supported repair/reassessment or authorized obligation change. Recovery can retain valid work without rerunning every check; complete governing assurance differs from freshness of every execution. Required assurance/risk/gates constrain total-cost selection, and no optimization removes a separate gate or dictates universal full-suite cadence; a full suite can still have gaps.

probes.title: Independent assurance and quantified confidence keep their premises
probes.source_selected_question: When are assessor judgments independent, and what follows from agreement or a computed detection probability under shared failure causes?

source_loci.quote: independence; shared mechanical evidence may be reused, judgment may not

required_distinctions.distinction: Where required, independent assessment is over a stabilized exact subject and cannot assess its own authorship or reuse the constructor judgment; shared mechanical evidence may be reused and an assessor may read the same governing sources. Fresh context is not independence; ported contributions retain authorship. Across-family independence is declared, and whether two same-family activations are independent for a semantic claim follows its governing policy, defaulting to not independent if silent. No fixed actor/round count is prescribed.

Assertion provenance (upstream obligation/interpretation/derivation/assumptions/shared dependencies), execution provenance (actual checker/subject/environment/inputs/observations/result), and returned-result authentication remain different. Agreement permits shared error, disagreement needs diagnosis, different actors/model families/codebases prove no statistical independence and repetition creates no new observation. An incorrect common model is not validated against purpose without the owning external observations.

Quantified assurance declares population/uncertainty, prior, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits. Bayes has a nonzero denominator and supplies no missing parameters. Exact joint-miss factorization uses prior misses in each conditional; defined conditioning events are required, and simpler factors need conditional independence under the declared model.

One minus joint miss probability means at least one detection under the specified conditions, not whole-product correctness; agreement need not increase confidence. Sampled/injected defects calibrate only a justified operational relation. Unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved with scoped qualitative evidence usable; no universal threshold or per-test probability is required, and a cheaper assurance plan cannot waive safety, authority or acceptance conditions.

prohibited_distortions: Relabel same-author fresh-context review as independent or assume same-family independence where the policy is silent.
Infer statistical independence or new observations from different agents, copied assertions or repeated agreement.
Use authentication/logs as proof of assertion derivation; diagnose the faulty party solely by disagreement.
Multiply marginal miss rates without the needed model, equate detection probability to product correctness, or assert unsupported confidence/thresholds.
probes.significance: This preserves the exact RC8 independence default alongside the separate statistical dependence account. Graph extraction confidence and actor agreement do not establish either kind of assurance.
